dialogues.jp: 「鍵閉めたか？」
dialogues.en: "Locked the door?"
dialogues.text: "Locked the door?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、行くか」
dialogues.en: "Then let's go."
dialogues.text: "Then let's go."

dialogues.jp: 鞄を肩にのせ、のんびりと歩き出す。
dialogues.en:
Swinging my bag onto my shoulders, I started walking
leisurely.
dialogues.text:
Swinging my bag onto my shoulders, I started walking
leisurely.

dialogues.jp:
舞い散る桜の花びらを全身に受けながら、並木
道を音夢と並んで歩く。
dialogues.en:
Facing the potrait of several dancing and scattered sakura
petals, Nemu and I walked down the avenue of trees in a
line.
dialogues.text:
Facing the potrait of several dancing and scattered sakura
petals, Nemu and I walked down the avenue of trees in a
line.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さんと並んでゆっくり歩くの、何日かぶり
　だよね」
dialogues.en:
"See, when was the last time you were able to walk so
lesiurely to school?"
dialogues.text:
"See, when was the last time you were able to walk so
lesiurely to school?"

dialogues.jp:
スキップするように音夢が俺の前に回り込み、
振り返る。
dialogues.en: Nemu skipped ahead and turned her head back to me.
dialogues.text: Nemu skipped ahead and turned her head back to me.

dialogues.jp: 「３日ぶりかな」
dialogues.en: "Just 3 days ago."
dialogues.text: "Just 3 days ago."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「もう、なに冷静に答えてるのよ」
dialogues.en: "Boo, why such a calm answer."
dialogues.text: "Boo, why such a calm answer."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「別に慌てて答えたって仕方ないだろ？」
dialogues.en:
"A hasty, hot-tempered one wouldn't be of much use, would
it?"
dialogues.text:
"A hasty, hot-tempered one wouldn't be of much use, would
it?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「別に慌てる必要は無いけど、気持ちの問題で
　す」
dialogues.en:
"That isn't a problem of hastiness, it's one of your own
prerogative."
dialogues.text:
"That isn't a problem of hastiness, it's one of your own
prerogative."

dialogues.jp: 諭すように、優等生なことを口にする。
dialogues.en: A lecture by the honour student.
dialogues.text: A lecture by the honour student.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……かったるいなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "Haah... whatever..."
dialogues.text: "Haah... whatever..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「もう、ほんとだらしないんだから……」
dialogues.en: "Sigh, you're really a slacker..."
dialogues.text: "Sigh, you're really a slacker..."

dialogues.jp:
言葉ほどには非難の色のない音夢の声を聞きな
がら、宙を舞う花びらに目を遣る。
dialogues.en:
Pretending to ignore the reprimand。 I began to study the
dancing sakura petals.
dialogues.text:
Pretending to ignore the reprimand。 I began to study the
dancing sakura petals.

dialogues.jp:
微弱な大気の流れにのって、ひらひらフワフワ
といろんな動きをしながら、窒息するぐらいの
数の花びらが、地面に着陸していく。
dialogues.en:
As the light winds slowly die out, the sakura petals float
their last and fall to the ground.
dialogues.text:
As the light winds slowly die out, the sakura petals float
their last and fall to the ground.

dialogues.jp:
「しかし、１年中咲いてる桜ってのも、かわっ
　てるよな……」
dialogues.en:
"These petals, blooming again after just a year... it's
weird."
dialogues.text:
"These petals, blooming again after just a year... it's
weird."

dialogues.jp:
ガキのころからそれが当たりまえだったから、
不思議には感じないけど、やっぱ変なんだろう
な。
dialogues.en:
Although I accepted this as fact when I was just a kid, in
the end, it's still strange,
dialogues.text:
Although I accepted this as fact when I was just a kid, in
the end, it's still strange,

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「私は好きだけどな。綺麗で」
dialogues.en: "I like it that way. They're pretty."
dialogues.text: "I like it that way. They're pretty."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「掃除が大変だけどな」
dialogues.en:
"I wonder if you'd think that way when you have to sweep
them up."
dialogues.text:
"I wonder if you'd think that way when you have to sweep
them up."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「もう、情緒がないなぁ」
dialogues.en: "Sigh, emotionless aren't you."
dialogues.text: "Sigh, emotionless aren't you."

dialogues.jp:
その情緒の掃除のために、かなりの労力と資金
が使われてるんだけどな。
dialogues.en:
In order to clean up all that "emotion", requires a rather
large amount of work and money...
dialogues.text:
In order to clean up all that "emotion", requires a rather
large amount of work and money...

dialogues.jp:
降り積もった桜の花びらを踏みしめながら、俺
達は学園へと続く道を進む。
dialogues.en:
Walking through the thick-lying sakura petals, we continue
towards the school.
dialogues.text:
Walking through the thick-lying sakura petals, we continue
towards the school.

dialogues.jp: いつものように。
dialogues.en: As always.
dialogues.text: As always.

dialogues.jp: ◆音夢と一緒に学園へ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Going to school with Nemu◆
dialogues.text: ◆Going to school with Nemu◆

dialogues.jp:
いつものように、音夢と一緒に学園へと向かっ
た。
dialogues.en: As always, Nemu and I head for school together.
dialogues.text: As always, Nemu and I head for school together.
